d: Addressing the INDIA bloc's rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan, Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav launched a scathing counterattack on Union Home Minister Amit Shah's 'Angad Ka Pair' analogy, remarking that when the political ground itself has slipped away, there is nowhere left to plant one's foot.
